verses.text: Then I was given a measuring stick like a rod, and I was told, "Get up and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the people who worship there.
But leave out the outer courtyard of the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given to the nations. They will trample on the holy city for forty-two months.
And I will give power to my two witnesses. They will speak as prophets for one thousand two hundred and sixty days, dressed in rough cloth."
These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in front of the Lord of the earth.
If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes out of their mouths and burns up their enemies. Anyone who wants to harm them must die in this way.

They have power to shut up the sky so that no rain falls during the time they are prophesying. They have power to turn the waters into blood, and to strike the earth with every kind of disaster as often as they want.
When they have finished telling their message, the beast that comes up out of the bottomless pit will fight against them. It will defeat them and kill them.
Their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city. In a spiritual way that city is called Sodom and Egypt. It is where their Lord was nailed to a cross.
For three and a half days, people from every people, tribe, language, and nation will stare at their dead bodies and will not let them be buried.
The people who live on the earth will be happy about their death and will celebrate. They will send each other gifts, because these two prophets had caused them so much pain.
But after three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood up on their feet. Great fear came over everyone who saw them.
Then the two witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here!" And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies watched.

At that same moment there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell down. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake. The rest were terrified, and they gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second terrible thing is past. Look, the third terrible thing is coming soon.
The seventh angel blew his trumpet. Then there were loud voices in heaven saying, "The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will rule forever and ever!"
And the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones in front of God's throne, fell on their faces and worshipped God.
They said: "We thank you, Lord God Almighty, who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to rule.

The nations were angry, but now your anger has come. The time has come to judge the dead, and to reward your servants the prophets, your holy people, and all who fear your name, both small and great. The time has come to destroy those who destroy the earth."
Then God's temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant could be seen inside his temple. There were flashes of lightning, loud sounds, thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
